claim_ceiling: OPERATIONAL ONLY. This record establishes byte-identity and set-relation facts needed to decide whether another same-question v68 evaluation cycle would be discriminating: (A) whether the git-tree content of every path under product/query/ changed between the last recall-measured accepted product head 5fb312e4 and the current accepted product head carried by the mount, together with proof that the mount carries exactly those current-head bytes; (B) whether the frozen 15-member flagship probe family is member-for-member regenerated, decided by the ACCEPTED precondition gate and not re-derived here. It makes NO claim about retrieval quality, recall, counter-authority content, source validity, language robustness, duplicate suppression, latency, cluster stability, geometry, serve verdicts or jurist usefulness; it moves NO bar and NO threshold; a NO_TRIGGER_FIRED verdict is NOT a pass for the product - it says only that re-executing an unchanged frozen instrument on unchanged bytes would be zero delta. It does not discharge ordered item (2), which stays gated on trigger B. Posture stays fail-closed: packet_admitted=false, machine_gate_ready=false, human_gate_ready=false, ready_for_owner_session=false, owner_decision_required=false.

exit_code_contract.0: measured successfully - the TRIGGER STATUS lives in the verdict field, never in the exit code, so no workflow can read a fired trigger as a job failure
exit_code_contract.2: NOT_MEASURED (git, mount, hypothesis unavailable, or pin drift); the record still writes its error and claim ceiling

If FALSE (trigger B fired), item (2) must be executed on the named family plus packet-of-record 39319405429.
hypothesis.H3_gate_itself_measures_only_identity: The instrument computes no product-quality number of any kind; every field it emits is a digest, a set relation or a copy of the accepted precondition gate's own output.
